_comment: Interface strings. Key-major so the two languages sit side by side for review. Swahili is a DRAFT pending review by a first-language speaker with business exposure (docs/localization.md). Placeholders in {braces} must survive translation; whole sentences only, never assembled from fragments.

foot.privacy.en: Your progress stays on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere.
foot.privacy.sw: Maendeleo yako yanabaki kwenye simu hii. Hakuna kinachotumwa popote.

banner.unverified.en: Practice figures — the money amounts here are made up for teaching, not real local prices.
banner.unverified.sw: Namba za mazoezi — kiasi cha pesa hapa kimetungwa kwa ajili ya kufundisha, si bei halisi za hapa.

banner.draftLanguage.en: The Kiswahili here is a first draft and has not yet been checked by a first-language speaker.
banner.draftLanguage.sw: Kiswahili hiki ni rasimu ya kwanza, bado hakijapitiwa na mzungumzaji wa lugha ya kwanza.

pnl.perUnit.en: Each one you sell brings in {price} and costs you {cost}, so you keep {kept}.
pnl.perUnit.sw: Kila kimoja unachouza kinaingiza {price} na kinakugharimu {cost}, kwa hiyo unabaki na {kept}.

pnl.unmet.one.en: {n} customer wanted to buy and you had nothing left.
pnl.unmet.one.sw: Mteja {n} alitaka kununua lakini hukuwa na kitu.

pnl.unmet.other.en: {n} customers wanted to buy and you had nothing left.
pnl.unmet.other.sw: Wateja {n} walitaka kununua lakini hukuwa na kitu.

pnl.cashRunway.one.en: Your cash covers about {n} more week of rent and wages.
pnl.cashRunway.one.sw: Pesa yako inatosha kulipa kodi na mishahara kwa wiki {n} zaidi.

pnl.cashRunway.other.en: Your cash covers about {n} more weeks of rent and wages.
pnl.cashRunway.other.sw: Pesa yako inatosha kulipa kodi na mishahara kwa wiki {n} zaidi.

workout.intro.en: This is where you stand right now, before your choice takes effect.
workout.intro.sw: Hapa ndipo ulipo sasa, kabla uamuzi wako haujaanza kufanya kazi.

workout.ready.en: Now say what your choice will do to that.

predict.question.en: What happens to your weekly profit?

secondLook.nothing.en: None of the lines moved much. That is why the profit barely changed.
secondLook.nothing.sw: Hakuna kipengele kilichobadilika sana. Ndiyo maana faida haikubadilika sana.

later.title.en: This came from an earlier choice
later.title.sw: Hii imetokana na uamuzi wa awali

trajectory.cash.en: In {weeks} weeks your cash would be about {amount}.
trajectory.cash.sw: Baada ya wiki {weeks} pesa yako itakuwa karibu {amount}.

trajectory.falling.en: It is going down. Something has to change.

profile.improved.en: You got better as you went on.

profile.limitationsTitle.en: What this does not tell you

profile.finished.body.en: Finishing is what carries you forward — not how many predictions you got right. Your record goes with you, and what it shows is used at the next stage, not to score you here.
profile.finished.body.sw: Kumaliza ndiko kunakupeleka mbele — si idadi ya utabiri uliopata sahihi. Kumbukumbu yako inaenda nawe, na inachoonyesha kinatumika hatua inayofuata, si kukupa alama hapa.

profile.stmt.calibration.en: Correctly anticipated the effect of their own decision in {correct} of {total} predictions.
profile.stmt.calibration.sw: Alitabiri kwa usahihi matokeo ya uamuzi wake katika utabiri {correct} kati ya {total}.

profile.detail.improved.en: Accuracy was higher in the second half of the playthrough than the first.
profile.detail.improved.sw: Usahihi ulikuwa juu zaidi katika nusu ya pili kuliko ya kwanza.

profile.detail.declined.en: Accuracy was lower in the second half than the first.
profile.detail.declined.sw: Usahihi ulikuwa chini katika nusu ya pili kuliko ya kwanza.

profile.detail.steady.en: Accuracy was broadly steady across the playthrough.
profile.detail.steady.sw: Usahihi ulikuwa sawa kwa kiasi kikubwa katika mchezo mzima.

profile.stmt.information.en: Sought information before deciding in {withInfo} of {total} decisions.
profile.stmt.information.sw: Alitafuta taarifa kabla ya kuamua katika maamuzi {withInfo} kati ya {total}.

profile.stmt.recovery.one.en: Faced {n} decision that reduced weekly profit, and continued afterwards.
profile.stmt.recovery.one.sw: Alikutana na uamuzi {n} uliopunguza faida ya wiki, na akaendelea baadaye.

profile.stmt.recovery.other.en: Faced {n} decisions that reduced weekly profit, and continued afterwards.
profile.stmt.recovery.other.sw: Alikutana na maamuzi {n} yaliyopunguza faida ya wiki, na akaendelea baadaye.

profile.detail.recovery.en: What they chose next is listed in the evidence below.
profile.detail.recovery.sw: Alichochagua baadaye kimeorodheshwa katika ushahidi hapa chini.

profile.stmt.coverage.one.sw: Alifanya maamuzi katika mada {n} ya biashara.

profile.stmt.coverage.other.sw: Alifanya maamuzi katika mada {n} za biashara.

profile.limit.1.en: This describes what happened inside a simulation. It is not a measure of how this person runs a real business.
profile.limit.1.sw: Haya yanaeleza yaliyotokea ndani ya kiigizo. Si kipimo cha jinsi mtu huyu anavyoendesha biashara halisi.

profile.limit.2.en: It has not been validated against real business outcomes. No such study exists yet.
profile.limit.2.sw: Hayajathibitishwa dhidi ya matokeo halisi ya biashara. Hakuna utafiti wa aina hiyo bado.

profile.limit.3.en: It should not be used as an automatic cut-off, or to rank one person against another.
profile.limit.3.sw: Hayapaswi kutumika kama kigezo cha kukata mtu moja kwa moja, wala kupanga mtu mmoja dhidi ya mwingine.

profile.limit.4.en: Figures in the simulation are illustrative placeholders, not researched local data.
profile.limit.4.sw: Namba zilizomo katika kiigizo ni za mfano tu, si takwimu za hapa zilizofanyiwa utafiti.
